items.title: Announcing The Launch of Vision Tech Academy: Online Directory of Educators (ODE): In Honor of John Panarese
items.description:
Discover the Vision Tech Academy Online Directory of Educators (ODE), a groundbreaking platform dedicated to fostering inclusivity and accessibility in education. Created in honor of accessibility advocate John Panarese, the ODE connects students with specialized educators in assistive technology, offering free access to students and affordable premium features for educators. Celebrate John’s legacy by supporting a resource that empowers learning, breaks barriers, and builds a vibrant, inclusive community.
